name: bocht
line: a whole backend in one Bend binary
question: Can an AI build a whole backend in Bend — and prove every claim it makes?
body: Bend series, part 1. A whole backend (HTTP, auth, rate limits, WAL storage, REST and MCP) written as one Bend program by an AI app builder, shipped with an evidence discipline worth stealing: no claim without a re-derivable result.
